chunks: We shall seal their lips that day; and their hands will speak, their feet testify to what they had done.
ai.seo_question: How will the hands and feet testify on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from verbal denial to physical testimony, illustrating how the disbelievers' own limbs will bear witness against them, rendering their excuses invalid. This concept of 'shahadat al-ajza' (testimony of the limbs) underscores the divine justice where the body itself becomes a record of one's actions, a theme often linked to the resurrection of the physical form in Shia eschatology.
